Exception / Query:
Subject: Applicability of UAE Fire Code Requirements to Sulphur Linear Storage Building

As per the AGES “Building Fire and Life Safety Specification,” the UAE Fire Code must be applied to all buildings. Based on the analysis conducted, Bidder seeks clarification regarding the applicability of the code to the Sulphur Linear Storage Building, given the following points:
1.	The UAE Fire Code is applicable to "Storage/Warehouse" buildings, defined as “an occupancy used primarily for the storage or sheltering of goods, merchandise, products, or vehicles.”
2.	Section 2.3, Table 1.1, specifies that for the storage of combustible dust, the occupancy category is classified as A2.
3.	Section 2.10, Table 1.18, imposes a maximum height limit of 15 meters for this type of storage building.

Due to technological constraints, the Sulphur Linear Storage Building cannot comply with the 15-meter height limit specified in the code.
Bidder kindly requests your guidance on whether the 15-meter height limitation applies to this specific building, or if an exception can be considered due to the unique requirements of the facility.
Company's Response:
-	Bidder to provide the reference layout or drawing which they are using in their query / clarification.
-	Linear storage is curvature type (Curved structure), it is important to understand / depend on where the height is considered, additionally it is not the whole height used for storage.
-	The building height limitation as per UAE F&S Code table 1.8 is for rectangular type ceiling building mainly the 15-meter height restriction is for the smoke detection limitation (detection range). 
-	After award TQ shall be raised to UAE F&S to get their approvals on the 15-meter limitation. 
-	Bidder shall continue with the same building height however all F&G detectors mainly smoke detectors shall be provided with height maximum limitation of 15-m to meet UAE F&S Code requirements.
